- You got the prod PG15→PG17 cutover fully prepped and opened PR #321 with Maya as reviewer: RDS blue/green Terraform — the read replica now follows the deployment instead of being destroyed and recreated — plus `runbooks/pg17-cutover.md`. Plan: 2 to change, 0 to destroy [1].
- You rehearsed the whole switchover on a snapshot clone: green ready in 52 min, 74 s of write unavailability, no data mismatch on the 20 biggest tables; the clone is torn down [1].

## What changed
- The window moved to **Sunday 22/11, 02:00–04:00 UTC** — Fernhill's month-end batch runs Saturday night until ~06:00 UTC. Maya approved #321 and cleared you to merge, but the runbook and the Notion cutover page still say Saturday 21/11: update both before merging [3][8][10].
- Renovate's PR #320 (AWS provider 5.80 → 5.82) is open and unreviewed; the blue/green work needs only 5.80+, so it does not block [4][1].

## What is still open

- Window coordination: give Lior 30 min notice before the switchover so he pauses the ingest consumers (they read `DATABASE_URL` from SSM, nothing to change there), and ping Daniel when you start — he is on call for the API side on Sunday [7][9].
